summary: Info Sheet #65 Integration App Store tested end-to-end. Backend: 16/16 pytest tests passed (browse lists 5 seeded published integrations each with installed flag + categories, detail returns capabilities/scopes/pricing+installed, install idempotent (existing:true on 2nd call), installed list reflects state, uninstall disables + subsequent uninstall of not-installed returns 404, admin list has install counts, admin analytics returns {total,published,active_installs,paid_installs,by_integration}, admin toggle flips published<->draft, non-admin -> 403 on both admin endpoints, regression: /api/education/tracks still returns 3). Frontend E2E mobile 390x844: demo_home login -> /profile -> profile-appstore row -> navigates to /appstore; header 'Integrations', help copy, 6 chips (store-cat-all + 5 categories: analytics, energy, insurance, pro, safety), 5 store-item-* cards. Tapping card opens modal showing capabilities bullets, permissions box with scopes, transparency note; store-close works; store-install taps consent alert then re-open shows store-uninstall (Disconnect & revoke access); category chip 'safety' filters catalog to 1 item. Admin: Diyhomieapp login -> /admin -> admin-nav-appstore -> AppStoreModule renders 'Integration App Store' with 4 stats (Add-ons 5, Published 5, Installs, Paid installs 0), Catalog with 5 store-admin-row entries showing category/pricing/version/installs/status, 5 store-toggle-{id} buttons; clicking a toggle flipped 'Unpublish'->'Publish' with a live re-render; 'Top installed' funnel section rendered.

issues: Admin nav is a horizontal-scrolling tab strip on mobile (desktop-first module); 'Integration Store' tab must be scrolled into view. Consistent with prior admin modules, not a blocker.

action_items: No fixes required for Sheet #65. Feature is production-ready.

(Optional cleanup — unrelated) Expo package version warnings persist: expo 54.0.34->54.0.35, expo-font 14.0.11->14.0.12, expo-router 6.0.23->6.0.24. Consider `npx expo install --check` when convenient.
(Optional) audit_engine.log_event is fired inside install/uninstall — spec did not ask to verify the audit sink; not tested here.
critical_code_review_comments: appstore_engine.py is well-scoped (~226 lines, single-responsibility). All Mongo reads project out `_id`. Async/await used consistently. Env-driven db & logger injected via configure().
Install/uninstall use audit_engine.log_event with medium risk_level — good for compliance/transparency messaging shown in the UI.
Admin router is guarded by Depends(require_admin) at router level (non-admin correctly gets 403).
AppStoreModule.tsx & appstore.tsx render only React Native primitives (View/Text/Pressable/Modal/ScrollView), all interactive elements carry testID, StyleSheet.create used. Good.
seed_data_creation: None. Backend startup seed_appstore inserts 5 add-ons if collection empty. Tests toggled insurance-sync twice (net-zero) and installed+uninstalled energy-tracker for demo_home (cleaned up post-run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sheet #65 App Store complete and green. Auth uses POST /api/auth/login returning {access_token,token_type,user}. Login page /auth?mode=login; submit text 'LOG IN'. Frontend uses Alert.alert for consent which does NOT surface as a browser dialog — verify success via backend logs. AppStoreModule sits in the admin desktop layout and is reached via a horizontally scrolling nav on mobile. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_appstore_sheet65.py (16 tests).
